description_html:
Key Features

  • High Airflow Capacity: Delivers an airflow rate of 7,207 cubic metres per hour, supporting efficient material collection and dust extraction in demanding industrial environments.
  • Advanced Filtration: Equipped with an 11-micrometre filtration rating, this hopper effectively captures fine particles, improving air quality and workplace safety.
  • Low Pressure Drop: Maintains a pressure drop of 817 pascals, ensuring consistent system performance and energy efficiency during operation.
  • Long Service Interval: Designed for durability, offering a service interval of 4,782 hours to minimize maintenance downtime and reduce operational costs.
  • Activated Carbon Filter Medium: Utilizes activated carbon as the filter medium, enhancing the removal of contaminants, odors, and volatile organic compounds from the air.

Main Benefits

  • Efficient Dust Collection: Ideal for facilities seeking reliable dust and particle removal, contributing to cleaner, safer workspaces.
  • Improved Air Quality: The combination of fine filtration and activated carbon technology supports compliance with health and safety standards by reducing airborne pollutants.
  • Cost-Effective Operation: Extended service intervals and low pressure drop help lower maintenance frequency and energy consumption, providing long-term value.
  • Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined post-acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions that fit specific budget requirements.

Typical Use Cases & Outcomes

  • Industrial Manufacturing: Suitable for use in factories, workshops, and processing plants where high-capacity dust collection and air filtration are essential.
  • Air Pollution Control: Supports regulatory compliance in industries requiring filtration of fine particulates and removal of harmful gases or odors.
  • Facility Upgrades: An excellent choice for businesses upgrading existing dust extraction systems for better efficiency, durability, and air quality.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Is this collection hopper compatible with standard industrial systems? Yes, it is designed to integrate seamlessly with a wide range of dust extraction and air filtration setups.
  • How easy is it to maintain? With a long service interval and accessible filter medium, routine maintenance is straightforward and infrequent.
  • What value does the activated carbon filter provide? Activated carbon enhances filtration by adsorbing odors and hazardous compounds, making it suitable for sensitive or regulated environments.
